rationale_highlights: The mitigating factors are J.F.'s very troubled and traumatic upbringing.
Both of his parents attended residential schools, and it appears that they have suffered the traumatic impact of that, including substance abuse and violence in their own relationship.
It is understandable that J.F. would have had problems in school given the separation from his family, and the abuse that he had witnessed or suffered at the hands of his own parents.
note: Youth home invasion; court lists traumatic upbringing as mitigating but effect on sentence is brief.
